finding.statement: Current main already excludes delta_id from stable replay identity and strips evaluated_at/delta_id from measured-evidence identity, but measured_packet() still serializes both fields into training-bearing packet_text. Therefore two clean Distillery rebuilds that first encounter semantically equivalent Forge evaluations with different envelope delta_id/evaluated_at can emit the same stable replay/measured identity while producing different packet_text bytes and potentially different accepted_dataset_tokens counts.

hypothesis: The training-bearing measured packet must use the same envelope-free preimage as measured-evidence identity. evaluated_at and delta_id should remain provenance metadata only, never training evidence.
counterhypothesis: Stable replay/measured digests are sufficient even if training packet bytes retain volatile envelope fields.
counterhypothesis_disposition: REJECTED_AT_SOURCE_LEVEL: packet_text and accepted token counts are dataset-facing outputs; allowing envelope-only fields to change those outputs makes clean rebuild results depend on which equivalent envelope is observed first.

changes: make measured_evidence_identity wrap the exact same stable measured_packet preimage
retain evaluated_at and delta_id as explicit observation/provenance metadata
define fresh-rebuild equality over packet id, packet bytes, replay digest, measured digest and accepted token count

go_tracks.track_a: ADVANCED_SOURCE_SCOPE: makes Forge-to-Distillery dataset materialization deterministic across clean rebuilds of envelope-equivalent evidence.
go_tracks.track_b: ADVANCED: enforces the reusable typed causal boundary that observation/evaluation-envelope identity is provenance, not measured evidence.
go_tracks.track_c: ADVANCED_DATASET_READINESS_SCOPE: prevents envelope volatility from changing future training bytes/token accounting while granting zero J-Space/model/training credit.

next_exact_gate: Run tests.test_forge_distillery_training_packet_rebuild_stable_873 together with current replay-identity and live-bridge regressions on the exact branch head using an explicitly admitted zero-cost execution surface. If green, re-enter current main and fuse only if no concurrent successor already closes rebuild-stable packet bytes. Runtime promotion remains separately gated on repository-bound live Forge->Distillery 1->1->positive-tokens and semantic replay +0 evidence.
